senses.gloss: कौवल n. (-लं) The jujube tree: see कुवल.

कौवेर mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
 1. Relating or referable to KUVERA.
 2. Situated
in the north.
 f. (-री)
 1. The Śakti or female energy of KUVERA.
 2.
The north quarter.
 n. (-रं) A sort of costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ
E. कुवेर the deity, affix अण्.
